description: A secondary dataset from the randomized Head Start Impact Study, containing treatment assignment, baseline covariates, and longitudinal cognitive assessments for low-income children, made available for education research.

description: A brief, game-like direct assessment developed for young children that measures behavioral self-regulation through rule reversal, attention, working-memory, and inhibitory-control tasks.

title: Headsprout Early Reading

description: HEALCARe is a co-produced one-week undergraduate nursing education programme on health literacy, respectful and compassionate care, and customer care, developed by Tanzanian and European university lecturers with clinical practice teachers.
title: HEALCARe health literacy and respectful compassionate care education programme

description: A 36-item, five-point Likert self-assessment developed by Kan to measure healthcare workers' infectious-disease emergency-response competence across prevention, preparedness, and response dimensions.

description: The HLC-N is a 39-item, five-dimension Likert-scale assessment developed by Bao Xuemei et al.
title: Health Literacy Competencies Scale for Nurses (HLC-N)

description: The HLKES is a questionnaire developed by Cormier and Kotrlik to assess health professionals’ health-literacy knowledge and experiences, including recognition of patients at risk of low health literacy.
title: Health Literacy Knowledge and Experience Survey (HLKES)

description: A Wessex Making Every Contact Count training programme that equips healthcare professionals with person-centred conversation and behaviour-change support skills.
title: Healthy Conversation Skills (HCS)

description: Healthy Harlem is a school-based health and wellness programme whose Get Fit and Prevention components promote students' physical fitness, nutrition knowledge, and physical-activity self-efficacy.
title: Healthy Harlem

description: Healthy Minds Innovations' Healthy Minds Program is a free smartphone-based meditation app that delivers structured audio lessons and guided practices for cultivating well-being skills.
title: Healthy Minds Program (HMP)

description: A Dutch whole-school health intervention developed and delivered through school boards, regional public health services, and Maastricht University, combining free healthy lunches with daily structured physical-activity sessions.
title: Healthy Primary School of the Future (HPSF) intervention

description: A standardized performance assessment in which children complete pictures and receive score-, time-, and age-level classifications, administered and scored using Pintner and Anderson procedures.
title: Healy Picture Completion Test

description: The Hearing Screening Simulator is a web-based digital-twin training tool developed by Mavragani Amaryllis et al.
title: Hearing Screening Simulator (HSS)

description: A whole-school, trauma-informed programme developed by the University of California, San Francisco and implemented in San Francisco Unified School District schools through tiered supports, staff training, consultation, and student interventions.
title: HEARTS

description: A co-developed health-equity framework with implementation supports that organizes actions to improve care and disrupt intersecting systems of oppression in healthcare.
title: HEC Health Equity Framework

description: A framework developed by Tondeur and colleagues that defines digital competencies for higher-education teachers, including technical, pedagogical, and student-empowerment dimensions, to guide online and blended teaching.

description: A teacher-led foundational skills curriculum from Heggerty that combines explicit phonics and phonemic-awareness lessons for daily kindergarten through grade 2 instruction.

description: A 40-item Likert-type self-report assessment developed by Karcher for measuring adolescents’ connectedness to self, family, school, and friends across ten subscales.

description: A collection of stories for young children based on their everyday activities and interests, published by E.

description: Hero Elementary is a multiplatform K–2 science and literacy curriculum programme offering themed activity playlists for use in formal and informal learning settings.
title: Hero Elementary

description: A computerized 30-item multiple-choice assessment developed by Health Education Systems, Inc.
title: HESI Critical Thinking test

description: A public Kaggle dataset released through the Hewlett Foundation Automated Essay Scoring Competition containing 12,976 English student essays across eight prompts or essay sets with human ratings for developing and evaluating automated essay-scoring models.
